cohort: 796 pregnant mothers (398 advanced age (≥35 years), 398 adult age (20-34 years))
finding: Advanced maternal age was significantly associated with increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including pregnancy-induced hypertension, antepartum hemorrhage, cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery, low birth weight, low fifth minute Apgar score, and perinatal death.
mod_finding: Advanced maternal age was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
